steps.content: Guardian beasts howl as they race through the passage outside, oblivious to what lies just beside them. Horo and Lysandra have tucked themselves into a small alcove branching off from the main tunnel, taking this moment to hide and recover their strength.

Horo's dagger has been completely ruined in the battle. She clicks her tongue in frustration and tosses the useless blade aside, resigning herself to fighting bare-handed, when suddenly a new dagger and a familiar-looking flashlight sail through the air toward her.
Horo looks up with a furrowed brow, just in time to see Lysandra withdrawing her hand.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Some spare equipment, in exchange for an answer. Fair enough?

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: You're no tomb raider, and probably not a mercenary either. Yet you're willing to risk getting blown to pieces by these traps to keep going deeper. What are you really looking for, Horo?
...For an inheritance, the cursed treasure. Who knows which lucky soul has received this precious burden this time.
Horo gives Lysandra a guarded look, weighing her next words carefully.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: It's nothing good, that's for sure. If you value your life, stay away from it.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: You think it's that thing waiting for us at the end of this path?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I hope not, but...
Outside, silence returns once more. The two leave their hiding spot and head back to the main passage.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Whatever's buried down there, inheritance or not, it's definitely nothing harmless.
A dangerously powerful energy permeates the air. As they descend deeper, the Mania grows thicker, coiling through the narrow passage, just like when Horo confronted the inheritance before.
Horo turns to find Lysandra with an unusual frown on her face, deep in thought.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: What's wrong? Disappointed there's no treasure chest full of gold coins down there?
Meeting Horo's teasing gaze, Lysandra pauses momentarily.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: No, it's better this way actually.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: People here always claim Furor is the safest place as long as they have Fraser's protection. They put too much faith in others, which is dangerous. Tomb raiders who rely too heavily on external assistance usually end up dead. Always make sure your life is in your own hands.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: ...Sadly, not everyone understands this truth.
The pair venture deeper into the secret tunnel. Strange metallic patterns are embedded in the rock walls, activated by Mania, forming unusual, almost eerie streaks along the passage.

The tunnel finally levels out, revealing a stone door at its end. Just as Horo moves to push it open, Lysandra holds her back. Frowning, she leans closer to the door and hears muffled movements from the other side...
[Background: Underground Laboratory - Dimly Lit]

Their view suddenly opens up into a cavernous chamber. The dome soars high overhead, from which hangs an enormous metal sphere. Something is seeping out through the cracks in the sphere's surface, trickling down into a pool below.
Meanwhile, two figures stand at the center of the room. The taller one examines the massive apparatus with apparent curiosity.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: —Wow, you've already gotten this far? That's some solid progress indeed.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But the current yield isn't stable enough yet. We'll need to implement further optimizations.
Synex gives the report a cursory glance before changing the subject entirely.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh, by the way, what's the story with those prisoners? Did they come here specifically from DisCity?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Just some lost travelers. Furor has always harbored strong animosity toward DisCity, and these people were merely caught in the crossfire. They'll be released soon.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hmm, I see...

Done flipping through the report, the woman reveals a hidden compartment in the wall and tucks the documents back inside. She appears to murmur something else, causing the girl beside her to frown. Hypatia ultimately sighs before leading Synex out through another exit.
After making sure the two have left, Horo carefully pushes open the stone door and enters the chamber.
There are no inheritance or sarcophagi here, and upon entering this chamber, the previously pervasive Mania has vanished as if it never existed at all.
At the center of the room, a metallic liquid flows from a massive sphere, dripping down slowly.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Aurum Secretum. The barrier surrounding Furor is made of this stuff. Apparently, it can substitute Hypercubes and block Mania completely.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Is it... being refined? Or...

The central sphere rotates continuously, emitting a soft hum. The liquid metal pools beneath it before flowing through carved channels in the floor, spreading in all directions and disappearing into the base of the walls.
Horo frowns. She pulls out the photo she's been carrying. The blurry image clearly shows this exact location. But there's no trace of the Deus Corpus here, nor anyone waiting to meet her.
...Who the hell sent this photo? And what exactly are they trying to accomplish?
Lysandra surveys the room and locates where the woman has stored her report. She disables the lock to reveal a narrow compartment, functioning merely as a small safe.
She turns the pages to reveal neatly printed text.

█ Fraser Institute - Furor Experiment Site

█ Research Report on Aurum Secretum Properties
█ Project Number: FRI-AS-07

■ Part One: Resonance Property Test
[Test Sample I-113] - Hypercube

█ Objective: Induce resonance between Aurum Secretum and Hypercubes to acquire anti-Mania properties and test potential resource substitution.
█ Procedure: Following resonance experiments with Sample 1, the surrounding Mania field temporarily stabilized, with no significant depletion observed in Sample 1. The Fraser Kardas barrier device designed based on this resonance effect has entered preliminary testing phase.

█ Results: According to observations at the Furor experiment site, while the Fraser Kardas demonstrates some degree of anti-Mania field effects, a continuous supply of highly pure Aurum Secretum is required, or its effectiveness will rapidly deteriorate.

█ Conclusion: Aurum Secretum cannot replace Hypercubes.

[Test Sample II-052] - Mania Crystal

█ Objective: Induce resonance between Aurum Secretum and Mania Crystals to amplify its offensive properties for mass destruction weapon development.

█ Procedure: Following resonance experiments with Sample 2, the induced Mania field was observed to instantly enter a polarized state.

█ Results: Mania weapons developed based on this resonance effect exhibit excessive side effects, rendering them unsuitable as conventional equipment.

█ Conclusion: Consider shifting research direction to develop self-destructive weapons based on this resonance effect.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: This is also Aurum Secretum? Strange...
Turning to the next page, large black redaction blocks begin to appear. Someone has deliberately censored certain information.

[Test Sample III-871] - Ash Crystal

█ Objective: Use ████'s ███ to create directed resonance between Aurum Secretum and Ash Crystals, enhancing Sample 3's suppression of ███ power.

█ Procedure: Resonance experiments with Sample 3 proved extremely dangerous. After several failures, research approach was modified.

█ Results: Multiple experiments indicate that ███ Aurum Secretum devices can effectively restrict the power of ███, enabling users to acquire these abilities. By increasing resonance output, it is possible to ███.

█ Conclusion: Currently, test subjects can withstand a maximum output of 72%. Overloading may cause mental contamination, physical disintegration, ████ and other irreversible corruption effects.

[Test Sample IV-001] - ████ ███████. ██████████████. ██████████. Aurum Secretum was devoured by the sample during the experiment. Sample activation proved extremely dangerous. Further operation forbidden.
As the redacted sections multiply, unease grows in Horo's mind.
Ash Crystals? Mania resonance? If Aurum Secretum was simply a technology to counter Mania, why would they need to experiment on so many different samples?
The report isn't over yet. They continue turning the pages.

■ Part Two: Test Subject Compatibility Experiments

[Test Sample I-001-53] - Non-congenital Sinner
[Test Subject] - ███
Non-congenital Sinner and disaster survivor. Exhibits high resonance with base-level Mania properties of N-02 ██. Related files transferred from headquarters.
██/██: Subject successfully controlled target using the Aurum Secretum device.

[Test Sample I-003-21] - Non-congenital Sinner
[Test Subject] - ████
In a non-██ state, the Sinner was ordered to force-resonate with Ash Crystals using regular Aurum Secretum. Stabilization was done externally with protective equipment.
Test subject displayed high levels of Aurum Secretum corruption with a short use period, but could exert maximum power within extreme threshold limits.

[Test Sample II-001-115] - Self-mutating Sinner
[Test Subject] - ████ ███
Subject was infected by Mania and became a Sinner after prolonged exposure to Aurum Secretum-related products. Despite several resonance experiments, this test subject's resonance output has consistently remained at low levels.
Currently, the test subject's mental state is stable with no visible signs of corruption on the body surface.

[Test Sample III-045-1] - ███████
[Test Subject] - ███ resident
This type of subject is vulnerable to resonance and is easily influenced by Mania, with excessively rapid mutation rates.
Currently, this approach has been abandoned. Related experimental materials were transferred to ██.
At the end of the report are the signatures of the persons in charge. Two names rest side by side at the start of the list.
Project Leaders: Hypatia Campbell, Adelaide Campbell

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: If it wasn't to replace Hypercubes, then why produce so much Aurum Secretum... What was their real purpose?
Thoughts race through her mind as she grasps at pieces of flashbacks.
The secret passage we just came through had guardian beasts and Mania-suppressing Aurum Secretum devices... Were those really just meant to keep intruders out?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Hey! Who's there?!
Lysandra yanks Horo backward as they retreat. The sheets of paper in their hands scatter across the floor, instantly shredded by incoming laser fire.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Alert! Intruders detected! Secure all positions!
Footsteps echo from every direction. Guards pour through side doors from all around the room, training their weapons on the trespassers who dared enter this restricted area.
